title: 智慧养老
text: 在养老院里，先进设备改变了生活。很多老人开始尝试智能产品。这些工具能减轻护理人员压力。凡是接触过机器人的人都感到好奇。它能陪伴孤单的长者聊天。机器还能提醒他们按时吃药。这样避免了遗忘带来的风险。目前，数字化管理已成趋势。健康数据被记录在云端。医生可以远程监控身体状况。这降低了往返医院的麻烦。凡是追求高质量生活的家庭都愿意投资。科技让照顾变得简单。但硬件无法替代情感交流。冰冷的金属缺乏温暖。孤独感依然是核心问题。我们需要在技术与人文间寻找平衡。单纯依赖软件是不够的。社会应当关注心理需求。志愿者应增加探访次数。只有结合关怀，养老才完整。未来，智能系统会更人性化。它将成为辅助而非主导。这种转变对社会至关重要。

questions.prompt: According to the text, what can smart robots do for lonely elderly residents?
options: Accompany them and chat with them
Fully replace all nursing home staff

questions.prompt: What does remote health monitoring via cloud data allow doctors to do?
options: Reduce the need for elderly patients to travel to the hospital
Eliminate the need for medication entirely

questions.prompt: What core problem does the text say technology alone cannot solve?
options: Loneliness and lack of emotional warmth

questions.prompt: What does the text suggest should be increased to address elderly emotional needs?
options: The number of robots per resident

questions.prompt: According to the text, what role should smart systems play in the future?
options: An aid or supplement, not the dominant factor
The sole provider of elderly care with no human involvement

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.

patterns.title: 被 passive
patterns.explanation: Marks the passive voice: the subject is acted upon. 被 introduces the agent (optional) and is followed by the verb.
